title: WordPress Launches Core Security Initiative to Crush Vulnerabilities With AI
content_md: WordPress has launched a new Core Security Initiative aimed at improving vulnerability handling, reducing unresolved security findings, and using artificial intelligence to identify flaws before attackers can exploit them. The initiative arrives as the WordPress project reports a substantial rise in incoming security reports over the past year. According to the WordPress security team, the increase is closely linked to rapidly advancing frontier AI models, which are making code analysis and vulnerability research more accessible across the ecosystem. WordPress Launches Core Security Initiative Rudy Faile stated that examining WordPress core can uncover weaknesses earlier, but the project must now scale its ability to triage, validate, prioritize, and remediate reports reliably. The effort was discussed during the WordPress security team meeting at WordCamp US 2026 and has now been formalized around three security priorities, collectively described as “ABC.” The first pillar focuses on strengthening the WordPress security-release workflow. The project plans to build a tighter and more automated process for preparing and delivering security updates. This includes improving end-to-end testing to ensure that fixes work as intended across supported WordPress environments and can be shipped predictably.
